title: Surreal Mosaic Muse
description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face and upper body composed of colorful mosaic tiles, with her mouth open as if singing or shouting. Her flowing psychedelic hair contains white horses, flowers, and swirls, while a spiral vortex of multicolored tiles emanates from her neck downward; to the right, a mosaic dog-like creature stands on a platform as glowing orbs project from her mouth toward it.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal digital artwork of a woman's face made from colorful mosaic tiles with open screaming mouth, her hair transforming into swirling psychedelic patterns filled with white horses and flowers, a glowing spiral vortex of rainbow tiles flowing downward from her neck, a mosaic patterned dog creature standing on a platform to the right with glowing orbs and light beams projecting from her mouth toward it, intricate line work, vibrant contrasting colors, dark background with cosmic elements, fantasy art style
